notes.title: 2024/2/9 Update Description
notes.notes:
1. Fixed a bug with missing flooring in some maps.
2. Adjusted the details of some random maps to improve the gaming experience.

notes.title: The game is officially launched
notes.notes:
Thanks to all game players for their support, the FPS+Roguelike game [b]"Abyssmare"[/b] is launched today. If you find a bug during the game, please generously leave a message in the comment area and the developer will correct it as soon as possible.

Just for releasing this game, I would like to thank my wife and daughter who have always supported me.
Thanks again to everyone who has supported this game.
